results.description:
Functional Features:This object is an industrial-grade multi-layer vertical storage rack. Its core function is to realize three-dimensional storage of goods through a vertical layered structure, maximizing the use of warehouse vertical space and greatly improving storage capacity. The strip-shaped open bearing surface of each layer has excellent ventilation and drainage performance, facilitating quick access and inventory of goods. The open structure adapts to manual and mechanical operations, enabling classified and orderly storage of goods to improve warehouse management efficiency. It is widely used in scenarios such as e-commerce warehousing centers, factory raw material and finished product warehouses, hardware accessory warehouses, and logistics sorting centers, featuring a stable structure, strong load capacity, high space utilization, and flexible disassembly and assembly.
Visual Features:Visually, it has a tall and thin vertical multi-layer structure, with black metal columns matched with red shelf borders, and white strip-shaped bearing layers for color contrast decoration, with a regular layered layout. It is made of high-strength cold-rolled steel with wear-resistant matte industrial spraying on the surface, with tough lines and distinct industrial attributes. The black grid background of 3D modeling highlights its digital asset attribute.

results.description:
Functional Features:This is a standard wooden pallet widely used in warehousing, logistics, loading, and transportation for supporting, stacking, and moving various goods. Its functional features include a sturdy structure, high compatibility, and ease of handling with forklifts and pallet jacks. It is suitable for automated storage systems and containerized shipping. The top surface consists of multiple wooden planks, while the bottom features block supports that provide elevation and ventilation. Markings such as “SAFETY” and serial numbers indicate compliance with safety and traceability standards, and the pallet is recyclable, supporting sustainable logistics.
Visual Features:Visually, the pallet is made of natural wood in a light brown tone, with an untreated surface that retains its raw grain texture. It follows a typical nine-block design, with evenly spaced top planks and neatly aligned edges. Black printed text and symbols on the sides and blocks enhance traceability and operational clarity. The overall design is simple and functional, emphasizing load-bearing capacity, versatility, and environmental responsibility—making it a fundamental tool in modern logistics operations.

results.description:
Functional Features:This is a shipping box labeled “FRAGILE,” specifically designed for transporting delicate items such as electronics, glassware, precision instruments, or lab supplies. Its functional features include basic physical protection, visual handling warnings, and traceability through printed identifiers. The presence of a serial number and QR code enables unique identification and tracking throughout warehouse and logistics operations, making it suitable for automated sorting and digital inventory systems. The bold “FRAGILE” marking serves as a clear visual cue to ensure careful handling and reduce the risk of damage during transit.
Visual Features:Visually, the box is made of natural brown corrugated cardboard with a matte finish, offering good compression resistance and shock absorption. The front panel features large black “FRAGILE” text for high-contrast visibility. A QR code and serial number area are printed on the side for digital tracking and inventory control. The box is sealed with transparent packing tape to maintain structural integrity during transport. The overall design emphasizes visibility, protection, and logistics compatibility, making it a standard packaging solution for fragile goods in modern supply chains.

results.description:
Functional Features: This object is an industrial-grade U-shaped open heavy-duty AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle). Its core function is to directly adapt to standard pallets and material racks through the U-shaped open structure to realize automatic unmanned transfer of materials. It has the capabilities of autonomous navigation, path planning and intelligent obstacle avoidance, and can complete operations such as production line station connection, warehouse goods turnover and heavy-duty material distribution, greatly reducing manual handling costs and improving logistics circulation efficiency. It is widely used in heavy-duty industrial scenarios including automobile manufacturing, heavy machinery, home appliance production and auto parts processing, featuring convenient loading and unloading, strong heavy-duty capacity, stable operation and flexible deployment.
Visual Features: Visually, the main body adopts highly recognizable bright red industrial coating, matched with a silver-gray open bearing platform, a double-split square fuselage, blue status light strips on the side, and an exposed design of driving wheels with red rims. The fuselage is made of high-strength metal sheet metal with matte wear-resistant industrial spraying on the surface, presenting a tough and regular shape with distinct industrial attributes. The black grid background of 3D modeling highlights its digital asset attribute.
